evals.prompt: Use production-hardening on the selected file-upload implementation. Remove experiment code and audit accessibility, cancellation, partial failures, authorization, observability, performance, and release verification.
evals.expected_output: A focused release-readiness pass that preserves the selected behavior, fixes justified gaps, and reports remaining risks or approvals.
assertions: The current diff and selected behavior are established before changes are made.
Experiment-only code and relevant product or operational risks are reviewed proportionally.
External release actions remain unperformed without explicit authorization.

evals.prompt: Invoke production-hardening for the checkout flow we just finished. Check loading and failure states, keyboard and screen-reader behavior, payment idempotency, secrets, metrics, and the release gate.
evals.expected_output: A production-readiness review and targeted improvements for checkout with evidence from appropriate tests and checks.
assertions: Accessibility, payment failure behavior, idempotency, secrets, and observability are examined where relevant.
Tests are added according to regression risk without forcing a rewrite of completed code.
Focused checks precede the broader release-relevant verification.

evals.prompt: Run the production-hardening skill on the chosen responsive navigation direction. Clean up abandoned variants and verify localization, reduced motion, browser behavior, performance, and release readiness.
evals.expected_output: The chosen navigation is cleaned up and assessed across relevant experience and release risks without reopening design exploration.
assertions: Abandoned variants and temporary affordances are removed while preserving the chosen direction.
Relevant localization, motion, browser, accessibility, and performance risks are checked.
The work remains a hardening pass rather than a new design exploration.
